summary: MINISO Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the release date of its 2026 June quarter and interim financial results on August 28, 2026, and a scheduled board meeting for the same date. No special-situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change, is involved. The filing merely provides routine scheduling and preliminary financial performance notice in compliance with SEC and Hong Kong Exchange rules. This is an ordinary earnings announcement notification, not a special situation, so mapping to a US equivalent would be a routine earnings release notice.
